database_summary: Star-like analytical schema for product sales. Core fact tables record transactions (sales) and periodic cost measurements (costs) linked to dimension tables for products, customers, times, channels, promotions and countries. Small lookup/dimension tables (products, promotions, channels, times, countries) provide descriptive attributes. Customers is a larger dimension with effective-dating fields (cust_eff_from/cust_eff_to) suggesting slowly-changing attributes. Supplementary_demographics augments customers for a subset. Currency provides monthly exchange rates to USD. Row counts indicate a large sales fact (~918k) and smaller costs (~82k).

accepted.name: sales_with_time_product_customer_channel_promo
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  sales.prod_id AS prod_id,
  sales.cust_id AS cust_id,
  sales.time_id AS time_id,
  sales.channel_id AS channel_id,
  sales.promo_id AS promo_id,
  sales.quantity_sold AS quantity_sold,
  sales.amount_sold AS amount_sold,
  times.day_name AS day_name,
  times.calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  times.calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  products.prod_name AS prod_name,
  products.prod_category AS prod_category,
  products.prod_subcategory AS prod_subcategory,
  products.prod_list_price AS prod_list_price,
  customers.cust_first_name AS cust_first_name,
  customers.cust_last_name AS cust_last_name,
  customers.cust_gender AS cust_gender,
  customers.country_id AS country_id,
  channels.channel_desc AS channel_desc,
  promotions.promo_name AS promo_name,
  promotions.promo_category AS promo_category
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN times ON sales.time_id = times.time_id
LEFT JOIN products ON sales.prod_id = products.prod_id
LEFT JOIN customers ON sales.cust_id = customers.cust_id
LEFT JOIN channels ON sales.channel_id = channels.channel_id
LEFT JOIN promotions ON sales.promo_id = promotions.promo_id
accepted.description: Denormalized sales fact joined to core dimensions (times, products, customers, channels, promotions). Use this when you need descriptive attributes alongside sales measures for filtering, grouping, or further aggregation. Preserves original keys for downstream joins. | Use for: Sales by product/category/month/year; Customer-level purchase history with product and promotion context; Channel or promotion effectiveness analysis; Filtering sales by product attributes or customer demographics

accepted.name: product_current_versions
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  prod_id AS prod_id,
  prod_name AS prod_name,
  prod_desc AS prod_desc,
  prod_subcategory AS prod_subcategory,
  prod_subcategory_id AS prod_subcategory_id,
  prod_subcategory_desc AS prod_subcategory_desc,
  prod_category AS prod_category,
  prod_category_id AS prod_category_id,
  prod_category_desc AS prod_category_desc,
  prod_weight_class AS prod_weight_class,
  prod_unit_of_measure AS prod_unit_of_measure,
  prod_pack_size AS prod_pack_size,
  supplier_id AS supplier_id,
  prod_status AS prod_status,
  prod_list_price AS prod_list_price,
  prod_min_price AS prod_min_price,
  prod_eff_from AS prod_eff_from,
  prod_eff_to AS prod_eff_to,
  prod_valid AS prod_valid,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN prod_valid = 'A' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, prod_eff_from DESC NULLS LAST) AS version_rank
FROM products
accepted.description: Choose the current/active product row per prod_id using prod_eff_from and prod_valid. Exposes a version_rank so downstream queries can select the latest record per product. Use when you need canonical current product attributes. | Use for: Get the current active product attributes for reporting; Join canonical product row to sales or costs; Identify historical vs current product records

  cust_income_level AS cust_income_level,

  cust_eff_from AS cust_eff_from,

accepted.description: Select a current/primary customer record per cust_id using cust_eff_from and cust_valid. Exposes version_rank so consumers can pick the latest active customer row. Useful for joining customer demographics to facts. | Use for: Attach current customer attributes to sales; Analyze customer lifetime metrics using canonical customer row; Resolve slowly-changing customer dimension for reporting

accepted.name: monthly_sales_agg_by_product_channel_promo
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  prod_id AS prod_id,
  channel_id AS channel_id,
  promo_id AS promo_id,
  calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  SUM(quantity_sold) AS quantity_total,
  SUM(amount_sold) AS amount_total
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN times ON sales.time_id = times.time_id
GROUP BY prod_id, channel_id, promo_id, calendar_month_desc, calendar_year
accepted.description: Aggregated sales measures rolled up to calendar month and product/channel/promotion. Use for monthly trend analysis and comparisons. Exposes measures quantity_total and amount_total and preserves grouping keys. | Use for: Monthly revenue and volume trends by product/channel/promo; Identify months with largest sales for a product or channel; Feeding time-series models or dashboards

accepted.name: product_costs_by_month
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  costs.prod_id AS prod_id,
  costs.channel_id AS channel_id,
  costs.promo_id AS promo_id,
  times.calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  times.calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  AVG(unit_cost) AS avg_unit_cost,
  AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price
FROM costs
LEFT JOIN times ON costs.time_id = times.time_id
GROUP BY costs.prod_id, costs.channel_id, costs.promo_id, times.calendar_month_desc, times.calendar_year
accepted.description: Summarize costs and prices per product per calendar month. Useful to compare cost and price trends or to join with monthly sales for margin calculations. | Use for: Monthly average cost and price per product; Compute gross margin when joined with monthly sales; Track price and cost changes over time

accepted.name: sales_running_total_by_product_month
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  prod_id AS prod_id,
  calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  amount_total AS amount_total,
  SUM(amount_total) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id ORDER BY calendar_year, calendar_month_desc ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount
FROM (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    calendar_month_desc,
    calendar_year,
    SUM(amount_sold) AS amount_total
  FROM sales
  LEFT JOIN times ON sales.time_id = times.time_id
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_desc, calendar_year
)
accepted.description: Running cumulative sales amount within each product across calendar months (ordered by calendar_month_desc). Exposes running_amount so consumers can query cumulative trends and compute month-over-month deltas. Requires a monthly aggregated input (e.g., monthly_sales_agg_by_product_channel_promo or similar). | Use for: Cumulative sales for product over time; Dashboard KPI that shows running totals; Compute share of year-to-date sales by product

accepted.name: sales_by_customer_demographics
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  sales.prod_id AS prod_id,
  sales.cust_id AS cust_id,
  sales.time_id AS time_id,
  sales.channel_id AS channel_id,
  sales.promo_id AS promo_id,
  sales.quantity_sold AS quantity_sold,
  sales.amount_sold AS amount_sold,
  customers.cust_first_name AS cust_first_name,
  customers.cust_last_name AS cust_last_name,
  customers.cust_year_of_birth AS cust_year_of_birth,
  customers.cust_income_level AS cust_income_level,
  supplementary_demographics.education AS education,
  supplementary_demographics.occupation AS occupation,
  supplementary_demographics.household_size AS household_size,
  supplementary_demographics.affinity_card AS affinity_card,
  supplementary_demographics.cricket AS cricket,
  supplementary_demographics.baseball AS baseball,
  supplementary_demographics.tennis AS tennis,
  supplementary_demographics.soccer AS soccer,
  supplementary_demographics.golf AS golf
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN customers ON sales.cust_id = customers.cust_id
LEFT JOIN supplementary_demographics ON sales.cust_id = supplementary_demographics.cust_id
accepted.description: Sales joined to customers and supplementary_demographics (when available) to expose additional demographic flags and attributes per sale. Useful for segmentation and behavioral analysis. Left join preserves sales even if demographic record absent. | Use for: Segment sales by customer interests (sports flags) or demographics; Profile high-value customers with demographic details; Explore purchase patterns by household size or education

accepted.name: currency_monthly_rates
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  country AS country,
  year AS year,
  month AS month,
  to_us AS to_us
FROM currency
accepted.description: Normalized monthly currency rates with explicit year and month preserved; useful to join to times by calendar_month_desc/year or to sales/cost aggregates to convert amounts to USD. Does not assume specific join keys — left for downstream queries to align by (year, month) or by deriving calendar_month_desc. | Use for: Convert monthly sales or costs into USD using monthly rates; Analyze exchange rate trends by country/month/year
